On this page

  1. 16–24 Sep 2026 (daily close values)
  2. 22–26 Oct 2026 (daily close values)
  3. What-if (not the strategy): without the ROC rule
  4. Re-test without the ROC filter (3 Nov 2026)

Standard setup (strategy5_standard_setup.md): daily chart, buy at the close when ROC(20) > 7 · close > EMA 50 · MACD histogram bigger than yesterday's · Stoch RSI blue crosses above orange with blue < 50; sell when blue touches orange. Also checked the "buy after 2:15 pm" experiment. Data available up to 26 Oct 2026 (TradingView export). Education, not investment advice.

Result: no buy in either window, for both the standard and the after-2:15 pm version.

At 2:15 pm on 26 Oct, blue was 54.5 (also above 50) and ROC −2.4%, so the after-2:15 version didn't buy either.

What-if (not the strategy): without the ROC rule

17 Sep would have bought 310 shares at ₹322.35 and sold at the 24 Sep open at ₹338.70: +₹4,779 after ₹290 FYERS charges. But the same no-ROC rule then bought 6 Oct (−₹2,372) and 15 Oct (−₹2,570). ETERNAL was going sideways (ROC near 0), which is exactly the kind of market the ROC > 7 rule is meant to skip.

Re-test without the ROC filter (3 Nov 2026)

Same rules minus ROC(20) > 7 (close > EMA 50 · MACD histogram rising · Stoch RSI cross up with blue < 50 · sell on the touch).

16–24 Sep 20261 trade: +₹4,778.971 trade: +₹4,208.10
22–26 Oct 2026none (26 Oct blue 52.87 > 50)none (blue 54.5 at 2:15 pm)

Buy at the close (17 Sep → 24 Sep): bought 310 × ₹322.35 = ₹99,928.50 on 17 Sep (EMA 50 309.55, MACD 2.16 / signal 4.04, histogram −2.28 → −1.88, blue 11.94 → 19.61, orange 11.97 → 14.51, ROC20 +0.73%). Sold at the 24 Sep open ₹338.70 (gap down to the touch level; blue 92.60 vs orange 94.25). Gross +₹5,068.50 − FYERS ₹289.53 (brokerage 40.00, STT 204.93, NSE 6.29, SEBI 0.20, stamp 14.99, GST 8.37, DP 14.75) = +₹4,778.97, held 7 days.

Buy after 2:15 pm: 308 × ₹324.10 at 2:15 pm on 17 Sep (blue 22.69 vs orange 15.54), same sale: +₹4,208.10 (FYERS ₹288.70).

But across all 50 Nifty 50 stocks (daily, buy at close, 2023 – Oct 2026), removing ROC is worse:

ETERNAL alone does better without ROC (+₹57,434 vs +₹10,970 over 2023–26), but the whole index does worse: 4.5× the trades, 4.5× the charges, and a −₹1.24L 2026. The standard keeps ROC 20 > 7.
